title: A Buenos Aires books contributor takes it to air on Neura — 'la confianza es el activo más subestimado de los negocios'
summary: Balayan heads Maure Inmobiliaria, analyses the Buenos Aires property market and has a standing books slot on Neura, where she recommended Incorruptible last Thursday. Her written summary is unusually faithful for a second-hand account: financial gravity as a silent force that grows with investors and short-term return pressure, the diagnosis located in governance and legal structure rather than in human greed, and Costco and Patagonia as the structural answers. Her own verdict is that trust is the most underrated asset in business. The line she opens on — that doing the right thing carries tangible costs and intangible benefits, so ROI logic pushes the other way — is Eric's own argument rendered in Spanish, not her coinage; he puts it almost identically on the Yaniv Bernstein podcast.
blockquote: La idea más potente del libro es que la confianza es el activo más subestimado de los negocios.
